title: No standards record stays advisory: each is enforced or retired with a written reason
body:
Why: Fable direction 1115e slice 5. Nine advisory records remain (3 tests, 3 wordpress, 3 frontend).
Outcome: each advisory record becomes enforced (with a check) or is retired with a reason.
Files: standards/records.json, src/brain/skill-harvest.ts, src/brain/retire.ts.
Proof: standards audit advisory count 0, false-red 0. Free.
